summary: Affinity Bancshares filed an 8-K on July 17, 2026, updating that Fidelity BancShares has received all regulatory approvals for its acquisition of Affinity via a multi-step merger. Per the March 30, 2026 Agreement, Merger Sub will merge into Affinity, then into Fidelity Bank, with Affinity Bank merging into Fidelity Bank. No specific price-per-share or premium is stated in this filing. The closing is expected in Q3 2026, subject to customary conditions. What to watch: regulatory clearance timeline and shareholder vote, with a risk-arb spread that may narrow as all approvals are now obtained.
